question_text: The Freedom of Information (FOI) Program in the Philippines, established through Executive Order No. 2 series of 2016, promotes transparency and accountability in government. It allows citizens to request access to official documents and records from executive branch agencies, subject to certain exceptions such as national security and privacy. The program aims to empower the public and enhance participatory governance. Based on the passage, what can be inferred about the FOI Program's impact on governance?

options.text: It will eliminate all corruption in the government.
It will make the government more open and responsive to citizens.
It will allow citizens to access any document they want without restrictions.
It will only benefit journalists and researchers.
